name: @optima-compliance/engine
description: Pure, clock-free compliance rules evaluator. Entity facts and rules in, filing obligations out.
author: StoneDogCode L.L.C.
//publishConfig: A scoped package defaults to RESTRICTED, which fails on a free account with a misleading 402. Set here rather than relying on `--access public` at the command line, so the flag cannot be forgotten by whoever publishes next.
//dependencies: Zero runtime dependencies, and it stays that way. This package is the B2B API surface and gets embedded in browsers; every dependency added here is imposed on every consumer and every self-hoster.
